blocks.text: Script B · listening. Read twice, at slow speed, with a break of 30 seconds between the two readings. Two voices if possible.

A · Reading. 1. She's a cop in Milan. · 2. In the city center ( ⁧فِي وَسَطِ المَدِينَةِ⁩ ); It's big and modern, near the university. · 3. He is a colleague of Hudā, Moroccan interpreter; He's tall, calm and very smart. · 4. A new colleague, engineer of Beirut. · 5. It is small but quiet; On the desk there is an old computer and a picture of Cairo, very nice. B · Listening. 1. In the evening (or in the afternoon): they greet with ⁧مَسَاءُ الخَيْرِ⁩ / . ⁧مَسَاءُ النُّورِ⁩ · 2. A Friend ( ⁧صَدِيقِي⁩ ). ·
3. From Morocco (not Tunisia, as you thought Salmā). · 4. Samīr says it's new and a little difficult; Salmā responds that it is difficult but important. C · Language.
3. . ⁧الغُرْفَةُ هَادِئَةٌ⁩ · 8. ⁧هٰذِهِ الغُرْفَةُ الهَادِئَةُ⁩ · 9. . ⁧فِي الشَّارِعِ صَيْدَلِيَّةٌ⁩ (or ⁧هُنَاكَ صَيْدَلِيَّةٌ فِي الشَّارِعِ⁩ .)
⁧المَرْكَزُ كَبِيرٌ،⁩ . ⁧مَكْتَبِي فِي مَرْكَزِ الشُّرْطَةِ⁩ . ⁧اِسْمِي لُوكَا، وَأَنَا شُرْطِيٌّ فِي مِيلَانُو⁩ ! ⁧مَسَاءُ الخَيْرِ⁩
⁧زَمِيلِي كَرِيم مُتَرْجِمٌ مِنَ المَغْرِبِ،⁩ . ⁧فِي الشَّارِعِ مَكْتَبَةٌ وَحَدِيقَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ⁩ . ⁧وَهُوَ قَرِيبٌ مِنْ بَيْتِي⁩
! ⁧إِلَى اللِّقَاءِ⁩ . ⁧أَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُنَا⁩ . ⁧هٰذَا دَفْتَرِي، وَهٰذَا الدَّفْتَرُ جَدِيدٌ⁩ . ⁧وَهُوَ رَجُلٌ هَادِئٌ وَذَكِيٌّ⁩

Criteria: Accuracy 4 = gender agreements and correct determination, complete vowels with at most two scrutinies; 3 = some error of agreement that does not confuse; 2 = Frequent errors on sentence/syntagma or gender; 1 = incomprehensible phrases or missing elements. Register 4 = greeting and leave formulas suitable for a new group, no dialect formula; 2 = formulas inconsistent with the situation. E · Oral production. The tutor uses the address book 6.3. Reference for level 3 in Fluidity: one minute presentation with a maximum of four pauses to search for words. For the Pronunciation, the oppositions to be checked in this form: ⁧ع⁩ in ⁧عَلَيْكُمْ⁩ , ⁧ح⁩ / ⁧ه⁩ , the ⁧هُوَ⁩ / ⁧هِيَ⁩ , ⁧ذ⁩ of ⁧ذٰلِكَ⁩ , šadda of ⁧جِدًّا⁩ And some sunny letters.
